capture.network_command: Cross-contract dispatch requires the helper to be a separately-deployed contract whose address the caller invokes. Both `do_cross_contract_work` and `HelperContract::multiply` are exported from the same WASM, so on-chain reproduction must deploy the WASM twice on testnet — once to obtain a caller address, once to obtain a helper address — and populate `budget.toml` so the caller is invoked against the helper. Steps: (1) deploy the WASM twice via `stellar contract deploy --wasm target/wasm32v1-none/release/amm_pool_contract.wasm --source alice --network testnet`, capturing the two contract ids as `caller_address` and `helper_address`; (2) populate budget.toml with `[functions.do_cross_contract_work]\nargs = ["--other", "<helper_address>", "--n", "100"]`. The --other / --n flag order matches the Rust signature `pub fn do_cross_contract_work(env: Env, other: Address, n: u32) -> u32` at amm-pool-contract/src/lib.rs:247; (3) `cargo run --bin cargo-budget-report -- --network testnet --source alice`. The binary auto-builds, auto-deploys the WASM, and emits one table row per exported function. Pick the do_cross_contract_work row out of the resulting multi-row report — other rows in the same WASM (deposit, swap, withdraw, do_expensive_work, multiply, etc.) are unrelated to the cross-contract measurement and must not be mistaken for it.
